summary: Treats RGB image values as XYZ point positions or vectors and applies 3D transforms, CHOP-driven transforms, look-at logic, alignment, and optional per-pixel weighting.

key_params.name: inputtype
key_params.note: Interpret RGB as positions or vectors.

key_params.name: xord
key_params.note: Transform order such as srt or trs.

key_params.name: rord
key_params.note: Rotation order such as xyz or zyx.

key_params.name: t
key_params.note: Translation; ignored for vector input type.

key_params.name: multiplyorder
key_params.note: Order used when combining CHOP and parameter transforms.

key_params.name: weightchannel
key_params.note: Second-input channel used as transform weight.

key_params.name: weightrange
key_params.note: Input weight range for partial transforms.

key_params.name: alignxformorder
key_params.note: Transform order used by the Align page.

common_gotchas: Translations are ignored when input type is Vector.
Output Normalize removes scale magnitude by renormalizing vectors.
The alpha channel is passed through unchanged; do not expect it to carry transformed position data.
Align-page calculations have extra cost because point dimensions must be calculated.
Weight-map input controls partial transform blending, so verify second-input range.
key_concepts: Treats RGB image values as XYZ positions or vectors and transforms them in 3D.
Position input applies translation, rotation, and scale; vector input ignores translation.
Transforms can come from page parameters, CHOP transforms, Look At, alignment, or combinations.
A second input can weight how strongly the transform is applied per point.
